title: Staircase quiver vectors are imaginary roots for d at least seven in the intermediate first-part range
author: Letellier, Emmanuel; Nam, GyeongHyeon
work: The Saxl conjecture and the tensor square of unipotent characters of $\mathrm{GL}_n(q)$

primary_locator.required_new_core: exact star-shaped quiver/dimension vector, central and leg reflections, defect/root criterion and staircase setup; explicit coordinate-labelled reflection construction/termination for d>=8 and original d=7 terminal cases

difficulty_reason: For n=d(d+1)/2 and n−2d<tau_1≤n−d, the author constructs a sequence of central and leg reflections increasing the defect until the dimension vector is in the fundamental imaginary-root region. Proposition 3.4 carries the reflection construction and termination inequalities for d≥8 plus the explicitly described d=7 exceptional end cases. This is a substantive research-level root-theoretic construction, not a direct application of the root criterion.
